content.title: Easter Prayer - The Society of Jesus
content.text: 05 Apr 2026 Communications Office Stories Lord Jesus, on this glorious morning, When you rose from the dead, May our hearts be filled with gratitude and awe For the love You showed us on the cross. May we be reminded that no matter how dark the night is The morning will dawn with Your light. May Your light shine in our world, May it bring an end to war and strife, May it bring unity where there is division And forgiveness, where there is vengeance. May we, as a people redeemed, live with hearts filled with the hope and joy Showing to the world, the vibrant hope of Your resurrection. Amen. The Communications Office of the General Curia publishes news of international scope on Father General, on the central government of the Society of Jesus and on the commitments of the Jesuits and partners-in-mission. It also handles media and public relations.
